name: publicrecords--govcon-opportunity-feed
description:
Federal Contract Opportunities: SAM.gov + Grants.gov in one. Which federal contract opportunities were posted today? Returns SAM.gov and Grants.gov notices in one feed, new-since-last-run deltas, and source links.

When to use: Use when you need new US federal contract opportunities (SAM.gov) and grants (Grants.gov) in one feed, optionally only items new since the last run.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "publicrecords/govcon-opportunity-feed" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/govcon-opportunity-feed

arguments.name: mode
arguments.desc: Mode

arguments.name: sources
arguments.desc: Allowed values: sam, grants. SAM defaults to daily Data Services CSV (samBulk=true, no key). Grants.gov needs no key.

arguments.name: samApiKey
arguments.desc: Optional when samBulk=true. Required only for API enrich (resourceLinks) / monitor checks / samBulk=false. Personal public API key from sam.gov (Account Details → Request API Key). Free. Stored encrypted; never logged.

arguments.name: naics
arguments.desc: 6-digit or prefix, e.g. 541512 or 5415.

arguments.name: agencies
arguments.desc: Names or codes, e.g. Department of Defense, DHS, EPA.

arguments.name: keywords
arguments.desc: Free-text keywords matched against opportunity titles.

arguments.name: setAside
arguments.desc: SB, 8A, HUBZone, SDVOSB, WOSB, NONE

arguments.name: states
arguments.desc: Two-letter US state codes for place of performance (contracts).

arguments.name: noticeTypes
arguments.desc: Filter by notice type, e.g. solicitation, award_notice, grant_posted.

arguments.name: postedWithinDays
arguments.desc: Only include opportunities posted within the last N days. Declared product default is **14 days** (Thursday product window).

arguments.name: deadlineAfter
arguments.desc: Defaults to today; excludes expired opportunities.

arguments.name: since
arguments.desc: ET calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) or RFC3339. Selects HF delta shards with eventDate >= since. Optional for snapshot (serves latest snapshot). For monitor, defaults to a 7-day lookback ending at the latest published delta date. Example: "2026-09-21"

arguments.name: includeDescriptions
arguments.desc: When true, fetch full grant synopses (slower).

arguments.name: includeContacts
arguments.desc: When true, include SAM point-of-contact fields.

arguments.name: enrichTopN
arguments.desc: Category leaders (or predecessors) per opportunity in enrich mode.

arguments.name: maxItems
arguments.desc: Hard cap on opportunity rows returned (and billed) after sort by postedDate desc → Sol#. Default 10000. Under the default 14d window, Active matches often exceed 10k — runs emit CAP_TRUNCATED + CAP_COVERAGE.covered/total (never silent). Cap always drops the oldest rows.

arguments.name: samBulk
arguments.desc: Ignored on the public Actor (v1.2 HF serve). Retained for input compatibility; private producer uses SAM Data Services CSV.

arguments.name: samEnrichLimit
arguments.desc: Ignored on the public Actor (v1.2 HF serve). Retained for input compatibility.

arguments.name: incumbentMode
arguments.desc: category_leaders (default): top USASpending recipients by agency×NAICS. predecessor: true prior-awardee/recompete join (stub until PREDECESSOR_JOIN.md ships). Proof schedules must keep default.

name: publicrecords--grants-gov-scraper
description:
Grants.gov Search API: federal grants list with deadlines. Which federal grants are open right now? Searches Grants.gov and returns opportunity, agency, deadline, eligibility and the source link.

When to use: Use when you need open US federal grant opportunities from Grants.gov with agency, deadline and eligibility.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "publicrecords/grants-gov-scraper" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/grants-gov-scraper

arguments.name: keyword
arguments.desc: Search keyword (e.g. education, cybersecurity). Leave empty for all.

arguments.name: agency
arguments.desc: Mapped to API body agencies (e.g. HHS, EPA, NSF).

arguments.name: status
arguments.desc: Mapped to API oppStatuses. Use forecasted|posted|closed|archived or pipe-joined.

arguments.name: postedWithinDays
arguments.desc: Server-side filter mapped to search2 dateRange (posted-date lookback). Verified values: 3,7,14,21,28,35,42,49,56,90,180,365. Omit for no posted-date filter.

arguments.name: openDateFrom
arguments.desc: Client-side filter on openDate. Accepts MM/DD/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD. Inclusive.

arguments.name: openDateTo
arguments.desc: Client-side filter on openDate. Inclusive.

arguments.name: closeDateFrom
arguments.desc: Client-side filter on closeDate. Inclusive. Useful for 'still open' windows.

arguments.name: closeDateTo
arguments.desc: Client-side filter on closeDate. Inclusive.

arguments.name: maxItems
arguments.desc: Cap on opportunity rows (deduped by opportunityId).

arguments.name: fetchDetails
arguments.desc: Hydrate synopsis via fetchOpportunity.

name: publicrecords--usaspending-awards-scraper
description:
USAspending API Awards: federal contract and grant awards. Who won federal contracts and grants, and for how much? Pulls USAspending awards by agency, recipient, NAICS and period, with award IDs and source links.

When to use: Use when you need who won US federal contracts and grants and for how much (USAspending), by agency, recipient, NAICS or period.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper

arguments.name: keywords
arguments.desc: Mapped to filters.keywords. Leave empty for broad recent awards; prefer agency/recipient/date.

arguments.name: naics
arguments.desc: Mapped to filters.naics_codes.

arguments.name: agency
arguments.desc: Toptier awarding agency name → filters.agencies[{type:awarding,tier:toptier,name}]. Example: Department of Defense.

arguments.name: recipient
arguments.desc: Mapped to filters.recipient_search_text (array). Example: Boeing. Verified shape requires an array of strings.

arguments.name: awardTypes
arguments.desc: Default A,B,C,D (contracts/IDVs). Avoid assistance codes that may list individuals.

arguments.name: startDate
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today − 30 days (recent awards window).

arguments.name: endDate
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.

arguments.name: subawards
arguments.desc: Pass subawards flag to search (default false).

arguments.name: fetchDetails
arguments.desc: Hydrate via GET /awards/{generated_internal_id}/.

arguments.name: maxItems
arguments.desc: Cap on award rows (deduped by awardId|generatedInternalId).

name: publicrecords--uk-find-a-tender-scraper
description:
Find a Tender & Contracts Finder: UK government tenders. Which UK government tenders were published today? Returns Find a Tender and Contracts Finder notices with buyer, value, deadline and source link.

When to use: Use when you need UK public-sector tenders from Find a Tender and Contracts Finder with buyer, value and deadline.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "publicrecords/uk-find-a-tender-scraper" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/uk-find-a-tender-scraper

arguments.name: keywords
arguments.desc: Case-insensitive match on tender title, description, or buyer name (client-side).

arguments.name: cpv
arguments.desc: Match when tender.items[].classification.id starts with any code (client-side).

arguments.name: noticeType
arguments.desc: Mapped to API stages: planning | tender | award. Omit for all.

arguments.name: updatedFrom
arguments.desc: ISO datetime. Default: 7 days ago.

arguments.name: updatedTo
arguments.desc: ISO datetime. Default: now.

arguments.name: maxItems
arguments.desc: Cap on notice rows.

name: publicrecords--eu-ted-notices-scraper
description:
TED Tenders Daily: EU procurement notices from Tenders. Which EU tenders were published today? Returns TED (Tenders Electronic Daily) notices with buyer, CPV, value, deadline and source link.

When to use: Use when you need EU procurement notices from TED (Tenders Electronic Daily) with buyer, CPV code, value and deadline.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "publicrecords/eu-ted-notices-scraper" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/eu-ted-notices-scraper

arguments.name: keywords
arguments.desc: Optional. Mapped to TED expert-search FT~"…" full-text. Ignored if expertQuery is set.

arguments.name: expertQuery
arguments.desc: Optional raw TED Expert Search expression. When set, overrides keywords / dates / noticeType / cpv / buyerCountry filters (you must include SORT BY yourself if desired). Example: buyer-country=DEU AND PD>=20260101 SORT BY publication-date DESC

arguments.name: publicationDateFrom
arguments.desc: Optional. Default: 14 days ago. Converted to TED PD>=YYYYMMDD. Ignored if expertQuery is set.

arguments.name: publicationDateTo
arguments.desc: Optional. Converted to TED PD<=YYYYMMDD. Ignored if expertQuery is set.

arguments.name: noticeType
arguments.desc: Optional eForms notice-type filter (e.g. cn-standard, can-standard, pin-only, pin-cfc-standard). Ignored if expertQuery is set.

arguments.name: cpv
arguments.desc: Optional Common Procurement Vocabulary code (e.g. 72000000). Mapped to classification-cpv. Ignored if expertQuery is set.

arguments.name: buyerCountry
arguments.desc: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 buyer country (e.g. DEU, FRA, NLD). Mapped to buyer-country. Ignored if expertQuery is set.

arguments.name: scope
arguments.desc: TED scope: ALL (archive) or ACTIVE (currently open). Default ALL.

arguments.name: maxItems
arguments.desc: Maximum notice rows to push to the default dataset.

name: publicrecords--legistar-meetings-scraper
description:
Legistar City Council Minutes & Agendas: meetings, items. What did a city council decide? Returns Legistar meetings, agenda items, votes and documents for any city on Legistar, with the source link.

When to use: Use when you need city council or county board meetings, agenda items, votes and documents from a Legistar client (e.g. 'seattle', 'chicago').

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "publicrecords/legistar-meetings-scraper" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/legistar-meetings-scraper

arguments.name: clients
arguments.desc: Legistar client codes. Use the hostname label of {slug}.legistar.com. Working examples: seattle, milwaukee, madison, oakland, sanjose, boston, denver, columbus.

arguments.name: dateFrom
arguments.desc: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD (EventDate / MatterIntroDate). Default: 30 days ago.

arguments.name: dateTo
arguments.desc: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today + 14 days.

arguments.name: maxItems
arguments.desc: Cap on dataset rows (events + matters combined).

arguments.name: resource
arguments.desc: Which Legistar collection to pull. Options: events = Meetings (events); matters = Matters (legislation); both = Both.

arguments.name: includeEventItems
arguments.desc: Extra HTTP call per event. Titles flattened into eventItemTitles (pipe-separated). Default off.
